# Bhrigav Dua

> Portfolio website of Bhrigav Dua, showcasing his work, projects, and contact information as a professional cinematographer and film producer.

## Primary Navigation

- [Home](/) - Main landing page introducing Bhrigav Dua's work.
- [Cinematography Portfolio](/cinematography) - Overview of cinematography roles, reels, and project experience.
- [Cinematography Work Detail](/cinematography/work) - Detailed listings and galleries of cinematography projects.
- [Producer Portfolio](/producer) - Overview of film producing roles, achievements, and production experience.
